implementation: Default-off cold q8192 producer with32x32 tiles, four explicit score carries, K128 staging and ordered K16 groups. Sixteen exact BF16 products enter a balanced native FP32 round-toward-zero tree and then the incoming carry. Only BF16 normal exponents96..158 or signed zeros enter; every unsupported dot uses complete original replay. Waves restore the prior rounding mode before output scaling. The current packed operand arena is refreshed without additional workspace.
correctness_scope: 1048576 host additions are checked against hardware FE_TOWARDZERO.1048576 native gfx1151 additions match the independent host specification.24 generated QK cases check all output guards, causal masks, supported finiteness, every unsupported-dot original score, immutable input and complete prepared encoding;64 CPU specification dots per case check actual tree outputs. All active waves audit actual entry, RZ and restored mode. The generated q8192 and q8193 cases are not model prompts. Original-score differences are diagnostics; neither bit identity nor model inference correctness is claimed.
arithmetic_change: The balanced RZ tree is not the original width26 integer K16 accumulator. Product correctness requires original GB10 prompt, complete captured continuation, first-logit tolerance and actual callbacks.
